featured.name: Polaris
featured.fact: The North Star, and a Cepheid variable: it pulses gently in brightness about every four days.

featured.name: Mizar
featured.fact: Look for faint Alcor right beside it: seeing both was a traditional test of good eyesight.

featured.name: Dubhe
featured.fact: One of the Pointers: a line from Merak through Dubhe, extended about five times, leads to Polaris.

featured.name: Thuban
featured.fact: It was the pole star when the ancient Egyptians were building their pyramids.

source: Yale Bright Star Catalogue, 5th revised ed. (Hoffleit & Warren 1991), CDS catalogue V/50; facts: see docs/night-sky-facts.md
